recognize_zh: HPLC 在 HbA2 window（滯留時間約 3.60 分）出現高達 87.5% 的單一巨峰、HbA0 僅 3.8%，鹼性電泳在 C/E/O/A2 位置有粗帶而無 HbA 帶，血片為小球性紅血球並有標靶細胞，符合同型合子 HbE 疾病。
features: Peripheral smear with small, relatively uniform red cells and scattered target cells; one polychromatic cell present
Many crenated (echinocytic) red cells across the field, most consistent with a preparation artifact
No sickle cells, spherocytes or nucleated red cells in this field
HPLC: single dominant peak in the A2 window (87.5%, RT 3.60 min), HbA0 3.8%, HbF 1.5%
Alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis: patient lane (arrow) with a single heavy band at the C/E/O/A2 position and no HbA band
Family HPLC: A2-window variant 27.5% with normal HbA0 (HbE trait) and HbA2 5.8% (beta-thalassemia trait)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that are small with scattered target cells; numerous crenated cells are present and are likely a drying artifact, and no sickle cells or nucleated red cells are identified. Cation-exchange HPLC shows a single dominant variant peak in the HbA2 window (87.5%) with markedly reduced HbA0 (3.8%) and HbF 1.5%, and alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis shows a single band in the C/E/O/A2 region without HbA. The mother's HPLC shows an A2-window variant of 27.5% with normal HbA0 (HbE trait), and the husband's study shows HbA2 5.8% (beta-thalassemia trait). In a patient with normal iron studies, findings are consistent with homozygous HbE disease.

ddx.vs: HbE/beta0-thal also lacks HbA but has a substantially raised HbF (often 30-60%), more severe anemia and prominent poikilocytosis, whereas HbF here is only 1.5%.
HbE trait shows an A2-window variant of about 25-30% with abundant HbA0, as in the parental tracing, rather than >85% with near-absent HbA0.
These co-migrate with HbE on alkaline electrophoresis but elute in separate C- or later windows on HPLC, and HbC disease shows intracellular crystals.
Iron deficiency causes microcytosis with anisocytosis and pencil cells but a normal or low HbA2 and no variant peak, and iron studies here were normal.
